arxiv-2105-11774.title: Bishop-Jones’ Theorem and the ergodic limit set
arxiv-2105-11774.creator: Nicola Cavallucci
arxiv-2105-11774.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicola Cavallucci. For a proper, Gromov-hyperbolic metric space and a discrete, non-elementary, group of isometries, we define a natural subset of the limit set at infinity of the group called the ergodic limit set. The name is motivated by the fact that every ergodic measure which is invariant for the geodesic flow on the quotient metric space is concentrated on geodesics with endpoints belonging to the ergodic limit set.

arxiv-2109-13831.title: T-product Tensor Expander Chernoff Bound
arxiv-2109-13831.creator: Shih Yu Chang
arxiv-2109-13831.description: Abstract In probability theory, the Chernoff bound gives exponentially decreasing bounds on tail distributions for sums of independent random variables and such bound is applied at different fields in science and engineering. In this work, we generalize the conventional Chernoff bound from the summation of independent random variables to the summation of dependent random T-product tensors.

arxiv-2112-00800.title: Iconary: A Pictionary-Based Game for Testing Multimodal Communication with Drawings and Text
arxiv-2112-00800.creator: Christopher Clark ∗ Jordi Salvador ∗ Dustin Schwenk ∗ Derrick Bonafilia ∗
arxiv-2112-00800.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Christopher Clark ∗ Jordi Salvador ∗ Dustin Schwenk ∗ Derrick Bonafilia ∗. Communicating with humans is challenging for AIs because it requires a shared understanding of the world, complex semantics (e.g., metaphors or analogies), and at times multi-modal gestures (e.g., pointing with a finger, or an arrow in a diagram). We investigate these challenges in the context of Iconary, a collaborative game of drawing and guessing based on Pictionary, that poses a novel challenge for the research community.

arxiv-2310-09920.title: BONES: Near-Optimal Neural-Enhanced Video Streaming Journal: POMACS Volume: 8 2 19 6 DOI: 10.1145/3656014 CCS: Networks Network resources allocation CCS: Information systems Multimedia streaming
arxiv-2310-09920.creator: Lingdong Wang, Simran Singh, Jacob Chakareski, Mohammad Hajiesmaili, Ramesh K. Sitaraman
arxiv-2310-09920.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lingdong Wang, Simran Singh, Jacob Chakareski, Mohammad Hajiesmaili, Ramesh K. Sitaraman. Accessing high-quality video content can be challenging due to insufficient and unstable network bandwidth. Recent advances in neural enhancement have shown promising results in improving the quality of degraded videos through deep learning. Neural-Enhanced Streaming (NES) incorporates this new approach into video streaming, allowing users to download low-quality video segments and then enhance them to obtain high-quality content without violating the playback of the video stream.

arxiv-2502-02827.title: COFFE : A Co de E ff ici e ncy Benchmark for Code Generation
arxiv-2502-02827.creator: Yun Peng, Jun Wan, Yichen Li, Xiaoxue Ren
arxiv-2502-02827.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yun Peng, Jun Wan, Yichen Li, Xiaoxue Ren. Code generation has largely improved development efficiency in the era of large language models (LLMs). With the ability to follow instructions, current LLMs can be prompted to generate code solutions given detailed descriptions in natural language. Many research efforts are being devoted to improving the correctness of LLM-generated code, and many benchmarks are proposed to evaluate the correctness comprehensively. Despite the focus on correctness, the time efficiency of LLM-generated code solutions is under-explored.

arxiv-2510-23337.title: BaZi-Based Character Simulation Benchmark: Evaluating AI on Temporal and Persona Reasoning
arxiv-2510-23337.creator: Siyuan Zheng ∗♣△ , Pai Liu ∗†♣♠ , Xi Chen ∗♣♠ , Jizheng Dong ♡ , Sihan Jia ♢
arxiv-2510-23337.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Siyuan Zheng ∗♣△ , Pai Liu ∗†♣♠ , Xi Chen ∗♣♠ , Jizheng Dong ♡ , Sihan Jia ♢. Human-like virtual characters are crucial for games, storytelling, and virtual reality, yet current methods rely heavily on annotated data or handcrafted persona prompts, making it difficult to scale up and generate realistic, contextually coherent personas. We create the first QA dataset for BaZi-based persona reasoning, where real human experiences categorized into wealth, health, kinship, career, and relationships are represented as life-event questions and answers.

arxiv-2602-16960.title: Capturing Secondary Kinetic Instabilities in Three-Dimensional Dayside Reconnection Using an Improved Gradient-Based Closure
arxiv-2602-16960.description: Abstract Magnetic reconnection is a highly dynamic process that excites a wide variety of kinetic waves and instabilities. Transverse current sheet instabilities such as the lower-hybrid drift and secondary drift-kink instabilities in particular have been shown by kinetic simulations to modify the reconnection and introduce significant turbulence and mixing to the reconnection layer.

pmc-13642115.creator: Sergejs Boroviks, Benjamin S Garcia, Ebru Buhara, Olivier J F Martin
pmc-13642115.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This article reports an experimental study of a plasmonic metasurface that supports the resonant lattice Kerker effect in the near‐infrared wavelength range, manifesting as the suppression of reflection in a narrow spectral range. Such directional scattering is explained by the interaction of electric dipole and quadrupole modes that are simultaneously excited in the meta‐atoms and also gives rise to a substantial near‐field enhancement.
